stances.summary: Agrees AI outperforms doctors on diagnosis/treatment but warns story is more complex
stances.quote:
I agreed with much of the controversial JAMA piece on autonomous AI by Zeke Emanuel, Vinod Khosla, Neal Khosla, and Abe Baker-Butler. Given a clean set of clinical facts, AI will often beat MDs on dx & Rx.
But there's far more to the story. My new Substack:
robertwachter.substack

stances.summary: Highlights tension between AI capability and misdiagnosis risks in patient-facing tools
stances.quote:
My latest Substack: the irony of ChatGPT Health's launch (it's awfully good) coming the same week as the first big lawsuit alleging a serious misdiagnosis caused by AI (in this case, GPT-4o).
What does it all mean for the future of patient-facing AI
robertwachter.substack.com/p/c

stances.summary: Warns AI backlash is spreading; urges tech leaders to address concerns over AGI hype
stances.quote:
The AI backlash is growing – from graduating seniors to the Pope. Can healthcare, where optimism is warranted, insulate itself? I doubt it.
My new Substack: the backlash and healthcare, and why AI's titans should talk more about this (and less about AGI).
robertwachter.substack.c

stances.summary: Explores AI's impact on medical education, EHR systems, and doctor-patient relationships
stances.quote:
I really enjoyed this chat with the amazing Kevin Pho (kevinmd) about AI and healthcare. We talked about knowledge tools (ie, OpenEvidence), med ed, deskilling, scribes, EHRs, and the doctor-patient relationship in the Era of AI.
kevinmd.com/2026/04/grad...

stances.summary: Argues AI will transform specialist knowledge into generalist-specialist hybrid roles
stances.quote:
In Health Affairs Scholar, Bob Kocher, Siobhan Nolan Mangini (both of Venrock) and I argue that – by scaling specialist-level knowledge – AI will create, in essence, the "generalist-specialist." We explore the far-reaching implications for healthcare.
academic.oup.com/healthaffai

stances.summary: Questions market dominance of EHR vendor AI tools and whether intervention is needed
stances.quote:
My new Substack:
Epic, the leading EHR vendor, has released >100 AI tools. Choosing them over third-party tools has become the safe choice for many health systems. 
I explore why, and the bigger questions: can – and should – something be done about it.
robertwachter.substack.com/

stances.summary: Warns of AI-based deskilling risks in medicine, advocates for sensible safeguards
stances.quote:
In today's Washington Post, a terrific piece on the risk of AI-based deskilling in medicine, along with some sensible recommendations. I'm quoted, along with Carla Pugh. Authors: Rebecca Adams/Laura Landry.
wpintelligence.washingtonpost.com/topics/2026/...

stances.summary: Discusses FDA leadership and AI regulation under current administration
stances.quote: What a joy to chat with my old friend Rob Califf about the FDA under his leadership (under both Obama & Biden), the FDA today, AI regulation, misinformation, clinical research & more. We also discussed his memories of being a UCSF medicine resident back in the day. www.youtube.co

stances.summary: Highlights gap between cautious healthcare AI implementation and rapid patient adoption
stances.quote:
Excellent Rock Health analysis of survey on patients' use of AI tools for health info. Big finding: doubling of use in the past year. 
Insight: healthcare orgs are implementing AI with lots of guardrails ("tortoise"); patients are diving in ("hare"). 
I'm quoted. 
rockhealth.com/

stances.summary: Promotes AI-healthcare conversation as meaningful intellectual engagement
stances.quote:
Of the many interviews I've done on AI and healthcare, this one (at the Computer History Museum in Silicon Valley) may be my favorite. The interviewer is the wonderful journalist and author Katie Hafner, who happens to be my wife.  
www.youtube.com/watch?v=_sZ5...

stances.quote:
A privilege to be interviewed by Michael Howell, Google's Chief Health Officer, for the wonderful "Talks at Google" series. Great questions, including on the shortcomings of the current healthcare system and the history of prior efforts at digital transformation. 
www.youtube.com

stances.summary: Frames healthcare AI as dynamic landscape requiring policy attention
stances.quote:
I've spent a lot of time thinking about UK healthcare (incl. chairing a 2016 NHS task force on digital transformation). It was great to speak to top UK health policy journalist Alastair McLellan for the Health Services Journal podcast on healthcare AI & "A Giant Leap."
www.hsj.co
